text: ぼくが　くちぶえ　ふいて　とんでくる　とりポケモン　かわいくて　なー！

structure.jp: ぼくが　くちぶえ　ふいて
とんでくる　とりポケモン
structure.en: the bird Pokémon that come flying

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ぼくが　くちぶえ　ふいて　とんでくる　とりポケモン
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing describes that thing. くちぶえ　ふいて　とんでくる　とりポケモン = 'the bird Pokémon that come flying when I whistle'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: くる after a て-form verb here shows the action moving toward the speaker. とんでくる = 'come flying over'.

patterns.name: 〜て (trailing off)
patterns.explanation: Ending on the て-form leaves the rest unsaid, as in 'so cute that I can't stand it'; なー adds feeling. かわいくて　なー = 'they're just so cute, man'.
